title: Wither Skull Dupe
description: Wither skulls can be duped just like how armor trims can!
body:
Dupe Wither Skeleton Skulls using a simple custom recipe!

This datapack is designed for players who simply don’t want to spend hours grinding skull drops. It makes progressing toward beacons and summoning the Wither much more accessible, while still keeping gameplay fair and survival-friendly.

✨ Features
🧩 Simple custom crafting recipe
⏩ Easy to get materials to ease the grind
🧭 Works great for servers and singleplayer worlds
🔁 No command spam or performance impact
🎮 Keeps survival gameplay meaningful while reducing grind
⚠️ Compatibility Note: If Minecraft shows this datapack as incompatible, don’t worry — it still works perfectly on all supported versions. This is only a version warning and does not affect functionality.

🧾 Recipe
7x diamonds 1x coal block 1x wither skull

📥 Installation:
🗂️ Datapack Method (Vanilla / Servers)
Download the .zip file
Open your world folder:
Singleplayer: .minecraft/saves/YourWorld/
Server: your world directory
Go into the datapacks folder
Drag and drop the .zip file (do NOT unzip it)
In-game, run:

/reload

Confirm it loaded:

/datapack list
